zh-Hans.wholeChartSummary: 这张盘应先从整盘路由首先经过 MARS；四轴框定命盘如何进入现实与变得可见；这张盘有分布背景，而不是一个“主导元素”捷径进入。这里的排序主题来自不同结构证据家族的整合，而不是逐星体目录。

coreThemes.headline: 整盘路由首先经过 MARS
coreThemes.summary: 在已选定的传统守护体系中，上升星座的守护星作为整盘层级的路由参照，用来显示命盘入口取向如何被导向；它不把该行星变成完整人格标签，也不把它当作命运控制者。 最终守护：SATURN、VENUS。

coreThemes.headline: 四轴框定命盘如何进入现实与变得可见
coreThemes.summary: ASC 落在 SCORPIO：深化方向。 MC 落在 LEO：辐射方向。 东方地平线升起点，用来组织命盘如何进入即时情境、如何被外界看见。它是象征性接口，不是固定人格事实。 上中天子午线点，用来组织公共方向、可见贡献与角色取向；它不保证事业地位或结果。

coreThemes.headline: 这张盘有分布背景，而不是一个“主导元素”捷径
coreThemes.summary: 元素以 EARTH 为唯一最高计数（7/10）。 模式以 CARDINAL 为唯一最高计数（5/10）。 当某一元素在登记统计范围内拥有唯一最高计数时，可以称为“最具代表性的元素”。若并列就保持并列；两种结果都不能转成固定的心理主导标签。

en.wholeChartSummary: Read this chart first through Chart routing centers on MARS; Angles frame how the chart enters and becomes visible; The chart has a distribution context, not a single “dominant element” shortcut. These are ranked synthesis themes built from distinct structural evidence families rather than a planet-by-planet directory.

coreThemes.headline: Chart routing centers on MARS
coreThemes.summary: Under the selected traditional rulership school, the ruler of the Ascendant sign is used as a chart-level routing reference. It highlights where the chart’s entry orientation is routed, without making that planet a total personality label or fate controller. Final dispositors: SATURN, VENUS.

coreThemes.headline: Angles frame how the chart enters and becomes visible
coreThemes.summary: ASC in SCORPIO: Intensifying direction. MC in LEO: Radiating direction. The eastern horizon point used to organize how the chart meets immediate situations and becomes outwardly legible. It is a symbolic interface, not a fixed identity fact. The upper meridian point used to organize public direction, visible contribution and role orientation. It does not guarantee career status or outcomes.

coreThemes.headline: The chart has a distribution context, not a single “dominant element” shortcut
coreThemes.summary: EARTH is the most represented element (7/10). CARDINAL is the most represented modality (5/10). When one element has the unique highest count, it may be named the most represented element in the registered counting scope. A tie stays a tie; neither result is converted into a fixed psychological dominance label.
